bio: Overflowing in charm, this townhouse appointed in a contemporary vein sports an idyllic terrace overlooking the kitchen garden of chef Olivier Bauche. The chef works with sincere affection and a warm heart and doesn’t hesitate to try out new ideas, sometimes surprising us with amusing combinations of sweet and sour flavours or, for example, with a spicy lovage ice cream that he serves with a saddle of medium rare lamb. In season, he frequently has game from Ardennes on the menu. Dive into the wine list safe in the knowledge that La Gloriette Hotel, just opposite, can put you up for the night in style......
